'''Polibo''' (Japanese: '''ニョたろう''' ''Nyotaro''), known as '''Poltaro''' in [[Chuang Yi]]'s translations, is a {{p|Politoed}} that {{adv|Gold}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and his second {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} overall. As of ''[[PS456|All About Arceus V]]'', he is at [[level]] 80 and his [[Characteristic]] is that he is "capable of taking hits."

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}===
[[File:Gold and Polibo.png|thumb|left|150px|Polibo and Gold]]
Prior to the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}, Poliwag was a wild Pokémon that settled at {{adv|Gold}}'s home. Politoed first appeared as a {{p|Poliwag}} in ''[[PS091|Murkrow Row]]'', as one of the family Pokémon at Gold's home that he grew up with. When the [[Team Rocket]] grunts stole Gold's [[bag|backpack]], containing the {{i|Poké Ball}}s of his family Pokémon, Polibo's Poké Ball was washed away by the stream and ended up with a wild {{p|Granbull}}. In ''[[PS101|Teddiursa's Picnic]]'', Gold found and defeated the Granbull and regained Polibo. 

In ''[[PS103|You Ain't Nothin' but a Houndour]]'', Gold had his first encounter with the [[Masked Man]]. His attempts to avoid him were ruined by Polibo being curious about his {{p|Gastly}}, resulting in Gold fighting him. Soon after the fight started Polibo was hit by Gastly's {{m|Shadow Ball}}, forcing Gold to run and hide.

In ''[[PS108|Quilava Quandary]]'', Polibo was seen training inside the Pokémon [[Day Care]], defeating a {{p|Donphan}}. While he was there he saw a commemoration picture of {{adv|Red}}'s party after his victory over the [[Indigo League]]. He had hopes to [[evolving]] into a {{p|Poliwrath}}, just like how [[Poli]] turned out. After the training was over the [[Day Care Lady]] gave Gold and Polibo a [[King's Rock]] as a gift.

In ''[[PS109|Ampharos Amore]]'', Gold and {{adv|Silver}} become trapped under the collapsed [[Bell Tower|Tin Tower]]. Silver tells Gold to send out his {{type|Water}} Pokémon because water will pull up underground water, which will allow them to escape. Gold sends out Polibo but the maximum amount of water that Polibo can use is too small. Polibo then evolves into Poliwhirl and Silver tells Gold to [[trade]] using the [[Pokédex]]. Gold trades him for {{p|Seadra}} just as the tower is completely filled with mud. Then, water shoots out of the tower, along with Silver, Gold, {{TP|Silver|Croconaw}}, and Gold's evolved Politoed. [[PS110|After]] they escape [[Team Rocket]] appears and attacks the group. After a brief fight Gold tells Polibo to use {{m|Water Gun}}, but Polibo ignores him. Silver takes over and commands Polibo to attack their {{p|Piloswine}}, and with the power of liquefaction and Polibo's {{m|Whirlpool}}, Piloswine is defeated. Afterwards Silver trades Polibo back to Gold.
[[File:King's Rock Adventures.png|thumb|150px|left|The King's Rock Polibo used to evolve]]
In ''[[PS111|Tyranitar War]]'', Polibo is sent out to battle against Silver's {{p|Tyranitar}}, and attempts to attack with his advantageous water attacks, but is thwarted by {{TP|Silver|Murkrow}} and beaten. Polibo is later used in ''[[PS113|Delibird Delivery - 1]]'' to battle against the Masked Man again. Gold has Polibo use {{m|Dynamic Punch}}, but Polibo's hand becomes frozen in the process.

In ''[[PS164|Slick Slowking]]'', Polibo battled against [[Sham]] and [[Carl]]. Polibo attacks with {{m|Hypnosis}} and manages to put his opponents to sleep, but is stopped when their {{p|Slowking}} and {{p|Magcargo}} continue to attack through {{m|Snore}} and {{m|Sleep Talk}}. Magcargo attacks with a powerful {{t|Fire}} attack and overwhelms Polibo, forcing Gold to recall him. 

In ''[[PS172|The Last Battle VI]]'', Polibo participated in Gold's last battle against the Masked Man. Knowing that {{p|Delibird}} was key to the Masked Man's strategy he had Polibo defeat it with a {{m|Perish Song}}, though this also took him out of the fight.

==={{MangaArc|Emerald}}===
[[File:Poli and Polibo.png|thumb|right|150px|Polibo and Poli]]
In ''[[PS335|The Final Battle VIII]]'', Polibo joined forces with Red's Poli while battling against [[Guile Hideout]]. After saving {{adv|Emerald}} and his {{TP|Emerald|Dusclops}} from {{adv|Jirachi}}'s {{m|Doom Desire}} attack, Poli used {{m|Double Team}} to confuse Guile Hideout so that Polibo could get a chance to sneak closer and attack. Although Guile Hideout tried to send his {{p|Walrein}} and {{p|Masquerain}} to attack the Tadpole and Frog Pokémon, they simply threw them away and attacked Guile Hideout directly, breaking his armor.

==={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}===
[[File:Polibo Pokéathlon.png|thumb|left|200px|Polibo in the Pokéathlon Power Course]]
In ''[[PS442|Out-Odding Oddish]]'', Polibo participated in the [[Pokéathlon]] alongside [[Aibo]] and [[Exbo]]. They started with the Skill Course, which ended with the round Snow Throw. The team threw snowballs at their opponents, with Aibo creating a gigantic one to earn them enough points to win. The same three later entered into the Stamina Course and managed to win that one as well. 

In the [[PS443|next chapter]], the three entered the Power Course and went up against [[Koga]], [[Bruno]], and [[Will]]. They struggled against the [[Elite Four]] member's team in Circle Push and Goal Roll before entering the final match, Block Smash. In it, Gold faced Bruno and his {{p|Machamp}} as his final opponents. By having Aibo focus on critical hits against the blocks, the team was able to enter High Tension mode, allowing them to quickly catch up with Machamp's raw strength and win.

In ''[[PS444|One Tough Togepi]]'', Gold sends out Polibo alongside his other Pokémon, save [[Togebo]], to fight and distract [[Lance's Dragonite]], who was going on a rampage. With Aibo and the others distracting the Dragon Pokémon, Togebo was able to finish the battle with a powerful {{m|Double-Edge}}.

In ''[[PS459|All About Arceus VIII]]'', Polibo fought against {{adv|Arceus}}. He attacks with a powerful {{m|Bounce}}, but fails to do any real damage.
{{-}}

==Personality and characteristics==
As a Poliwag, Polibo was an innocent and absent-minded individual, often getting into trouble by wandering away due to his curiosity. Polibo is also very high-spirited and gets excited when he accomplishes something. Despite being with {{adv|Gold}} since childhood, Polibo had no hesitancy in ignoring Gold when he was under {{adv|Silver}}'s command, showing a strong sense of commitment. After [[evolving]], Polibo became a very confident and powerful battler, being one of Gold's most trusted Pokémon.

==Trivia==
* Polibo, along with [[Kitty]] and [[Togebo]], is tied for taking the least amount of time to evolve twice, taking less than 1 chapter.
* Polibo is the only Pokémon in [[Pokémon Adventures]] to have used the move {{m|Perish Song}}.
* Polibo, as a Politoed, was the only one of its [[Pokémon (species)|species]] to appear in Pokémon Adventures.
